The NVIDIA kernel driver and the CUDA driver library on this machine are different versions, so SceneWorks can't use the GPU. This almost always means a driver update has been installed but the machine has not been rebooted onto it yet — reboot, then reopen SceneWorks. On an immutable/atomic Linux distribution (Bazzite, Silverblue, Bluefin, …) a driver update is staged into the NEXT boot, so a reboot is required even if the app has been running for days. Note that `nvidia-smi` can still look healthy in this state: it queries NVML, which version-checks separately from CUDA.
